This '''starfighter''' was in use with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[700 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
The fighter had three wings, with a cannon attached to each one. The cockpit only had enough room for the pilot.
They were considered to to fragile to safely land in a violent storm like the ones raging on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], and required a carrier vessel in those situations.<ref name="HOD" />

==History==
Five Jedi, including [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]] and [[T'dai]] used these vessels to hunt the [[Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader|leader]] of a band of [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="HOD" />
